In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the textbooks of the Portuguese language of Secondary School do not present a clear and coherent approach to the teaching of grammar.
grammar is not a mere description of language, but it is also a tool for teaching and learning language, which can be used in different ways, depending on the theoretical framework adopted.

the textbooks of Portuguese language of Secondary School, in general, are not able to provide an adequate treatment of grammar, in the sense of a functional description of the subordinate relative clause.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the teaching of relative subordinate clause must be done in the context of the reading comprehension of the student, and the grammatical analysis must be made in the light of the argumentative function of the sentence.

it is necessary to rethink the teaching of relative clauses, in order to develop the reading and writing skills, in particular the ability to identify the different types of relative clauses, to identify their function and to understand the cohesion that they establish with the rest of the sentence.

the textbooks of Portuguese language, in general, have not yet been able to integrate the grammar of the Portuguese language, as a whole, into the teaching of the relative clause and, consequently, the teaching of this grammatical category does not allow the student to develop the skills to read and write.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the grammar of the textbooks is a very important element to the learning of the language.
, although there is a great deal of variation in the treatment of grammar in the textbooks of Portuguese language, the relative clause is treated in a more or less homogeneous way.

the grammar is an essential part of language learning, and the textbooks of Portuguese language must provide students with the knowledge of grammar, in a way that is consistent with the theoretical proposals.
